title: GraphCompliance: Structure-Aware Regulatory Compliance through Policy-Context Graph Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2510.26309v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Regulatory compliance is an important requirement in many industrial and administrative settings. Yet compliance assessment remains difficult because regulatory requirements are distributed across structured documents and may depend on hierarchy, definitions, conditions, and cross-references, while the evidence relevant to a particular requirement may be embedded among multiple interacting actors, events, objects, and conditions in the assessed context. We present GraphCompliance, a structure-aware framework that represents regulatory documents as a schema-guided Policy Graph and contextual information as a Context Graph of entity-relation triples. GraphCompliance aligns the two graphs through a Compliance Gate, which identifies relevant regulatory requirements and evaluates them against the corresponding contextual evidence. translated_title: GraphCompliance：通过策略-上下文图对齐实现的结构感知监管合规
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.26309v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：监管合规是许多工业和行政场景中的一项重要要求。然而，合规评估仍然十分困难，因为监管要求分布在结构化文档之中，可能依赖于层级结构、定义、条件以及交叉引用，而与特定要求相关的证据可能嵌入在被评估上下文中多个相互作用的参与者、事件、对象和条件之间。我们提出了GraphCompliance，这是一个结构感知框架，它将监管文档表示为模式引导的策略图，并将上下文信息表示为由实体-关系三元组构成的上下文图。GraphCompliance通过合规门控对这两个图进行对齐，该门控识别相关的监管要求，并将其与相应的上下文证据进行评估。这种设计使监管结构显式化，同时将上下文事实组织成可比较的形式，有助（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GraphCompliance框架，将监管文档建模为模式引导的策略图、将被评估情境建模为实体关系上下文图，并通过合规门控进行图对齐，从而实现结构感知的监管合规自动评估。
en_tdlr: GraphCompliance is a structure-aware framework that represents regulatory documents as schema-guided Policy Graphs and assessed contexts as entity-relation Context Graphs, aligning them through a Compliance Gate to automate regulatory compliance evaluation.
